<a id="active"></a>
## 🟢 Dapat diperoleh

Ambang berasal dari pengamatan komunitas. Kontribusi privat dapat dihitung jika pengaturan diaktifkan.

<a id="starstruck"></a>
### Starstruck

<img src="../assets/badges/starstruck-default.png" width="96" alt="Starstruck">

Buat repositori yang mencapai **16 bintang**; tingkat lebih tinggi mengikuti jumlah bintang repositori tersebut.

**Tingkat:** 16 → 128 → 512 → 4096 (bintang repositori).

[Contoh nyata](https://github.com/torvalds?achievement=starstruck&tab=achievements) · [S21](https://github.com/torvalds?achievement=starstruck&tab=achievements) · [S03](https://github.blog/news-insights/product-news/introducing-achievements-recognizing-the-many-stages-of-a-developers-coding-journey/) · [S15](https://github.com/Schweinepriester/github-profile-achievements)

<a id="pull-shark"></a>
### Pull Shark

<img src="../assets/badges/pull-shark-default.png" width="96" alt="Pull Shark">

Menjadi penulis **2 pull request yang digabungkan**.

**Tingkat:** 2 → 16 → 128 → 1024 (PR penulis yang digabungkan).

[Contoh nyata](https://github.com/ljharb?achievement=pull-shark&tab=achievements) · [S22](https://github.com/ljharb?achievement=pull-shark&tab=achievements) · [S03](https://github.blog/news-insights/product-news/introducing-achievements-recognizing-the-many-stages-of-a-developers-coding-journey/) · [S15](https://github.com/Schweinepriester/github-profile-achievements)

<a id="pair-extraordinaire"></a>
### Pair Extraordinaire

<img src="../assets/badges/pair-extraordinaire-default.png" width="96" alt="Pair Extraordinaire">

Menjadi rekan penulis commit dalam **1 PR yang digabungkan**, dengan `Co-authored-by` yang benar.

**Tingkat:** 1 → 10 → 24 → 48 (PR dengan rekan penulis yang digabungkan).

[Contoh nyata](https://github.com/Rongronggg9?achievement=pair-extraordinaire&tab=achievements) · [S23](https://github.com/Rongronggg9?achievement=pair-extraordinaire&tab=achievements) · [S18](https://docs.github.com/en/pull-requests/committing-changes-to-your-project/creating-and-editing-commits/creating-a-commit-with-multiple-authors) · [S15](https://github.com/Schweinepriester/github-profile-achievements)

<a id="galaxy-brain"></a>
### Galaxy Brain

<img src="../assets/badges/galaxy-brain-default.png" width="96" alt="Galaxy Brain">

Memperoleh **2 jawaban diterima** di Discussions. Di `github.com/orgs/community` dinonaktifkan sejak 2024-02-06.

**Tingkat:** 2 → 8 → 16 → 32 (jawaban diterima).

[Contoh nyata](https://github.com/ljharb?achievement=galaxy-brain&tab=achievements) · [S24](https://github.com/ljharb?achievement=galaxy-brain&tab=achievements) · [S06](https://github.com/orgs/community/discussions/106536) · [S03](https://github.blog/news-insights/product-news/introducing-achievements-recognizing-the-many-stages-of-a-developers-coding-journey/) · [S15](https://github.com/Schweinepriester/github-profile-achievements)

<a id="highlights"></a>
## ✨ Penanda profil

Highlights adalah penanda program atau akun yang terpisah; ketersediaannya bergantung pada program.

| Nama | Status | Syarat | Sumber |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| **Pro** | Dapat diperoleh | Gunakan GitHub Pro. | [S01](https://docs.github.com/en/account-and-profile/reference/profile-reference) |
| **Developer Program Member** | Dapat diperoleh | Ikuti Developer Program dan buat aplikasi dengan GitHub API. | [S01](https://docs.github.com/en/account-and-profile/reference/profile-reference) |
| **Security Bug Bounty Hunter** | Dapat diperoleh | Laporkan kerentanan GitHub yang memenuhi syarat melalui Bug Bounty. | [S01](https://docs.github.com/en/account-and-profile/reference/profile-reference) · [S20](https://bounty.github.com/) |
| **GitHub Campus Expert** | Dapat diperoleh | Ikuti GitHub Campus Experts; periksa aturan pendaftaran terbaru. | [S01](https://docs.github.com/en/account-and-profile/reference/profile-reference) |
| **Security Advisory Credit** | Dapat diperoleh | Terima pengakuan dalam advisori keamanan yang diterima di GitHub Advisory Database. | [S01](https://docs.github.com/en/account-and-profile/reference/profile-reference) |
| **GitHub Star** | Dapat diperoleh | Dipilih untuk GitHub Stars; bintang repositori saja tidak cukup. | [S16](https://stars.github.com/) |
| **Discussion answered** | Historis | Penanda historis jawaban diterima; penggantian dengan Galaxy Brain dilaporkan pada 2022. | [S14](https://github.com/orgs/community/discussions/31629) |
